jobs.full_reason: It reads the catalog metadata and the $files and $snapshots metadata tables of every table, no data file.
jobs.full_cost: measured from the 2026-10-29 journal: 37 s a run (12:36:12-12:36:49 UTC), no data file read.
jobs.full_tracked_by: justified permanently: a production shape is a whole-catalog fact, and metadata costs no row
jobs.description: Capture the production lakehouse and Postgres shapes again, read-only, and publish them append-only to the shape ledger bucket, whose head CI reads to gate every pull request (root ADR-0259, ADR-0476); fails only when nothing has been published for 48 hours or a table is laid out against its cluster key. Runs after each deploy's migrate and daily after the loads.
